      About this item

      • Elite Performance - At the core of OnePlus 13s, lies the Snapdragon 8 Elite – the fastest Snapdragon mobile processor, powering OnePlus AI, stunning graphics and next-gen performance. With state-of-the-art Cryo-Velocity cooling system, OnePlus 13s runs cool, no matter where you are.
      • Smarter Everyday – Experience the power of OnePlus AI with Oxygen OS 15 out of the box. Oxygren OS 15 brings deep improvements that power OnePlus AI, making organising your life easy with AI Plus Mind, enhancing efficiency with Intelligent Search and improving productivity with Google Gemini.
      • Outlast Everything – At 5850mAh(typ) OnePlus 13s has the largest battery on a compact smartphone. It brings lasting endurance with up to 20 hours of YouTube playback, 16 hours of Instagram scrolling and 7+ hours of BGMI gaming. With 80W SUPERVOOC Fast Charge, charge up in no time.
      • Compact Powerhouse – OnePlus 13s brings a 16.05cm(6.32) Per-fit display housed in the most ergonomic form factor ever from the house of OnePlus. The 120Hz ProXDR Display brings movies and games to life.
      • Never Lose Focus – The 32MP front camera with Auto Focus, your selfies and groupfies are insta-ready, always. The 50MP + 50MP rear cameras ensure razor-sharp images with studio-grade details. With Clear Burst, never miss your precious moments.
      • Enhanced Connectivity – Be future-ready, with the first ever independent G1 Wi-Fi chipset on a OnePlus smartphone, support for 5.5G, and 360-degree antenna system for a seamless connectivity experience.

      How are ratings calculated?
      To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyses reviews to verify trustworthiness.

        I've been searching for a smartphone that offers excellent battery backup, a flagship processor, a compact design, and a refined Android experience. Finally, OnePlus has launched the 13S, and I must say – this phone delivers on all fronts.

        🔋 Battery Backup – 10/10

        Battery life is extremely important to me, and this phone exceeded my expectations. With its massive 5850mAh battery, even under continuous 5G usage, the backup is outstanding. A big part of the credit goes to the well-optimized OxygenOS, which is clean, fluid, and energy-efficient. This phone easily deserves a 100/100 score for battery.

        ⚙️ Flagship Processor – Top-Class Performance

        Equipped with the latest flagship chipset, the phone handles every task with ease. There’s zero lag, and the performance is butter-smooth, whether it's gaming or multitasking. It’s truly a beast in daily use.

        📏 Compact Design – Handy and Comfortable

        While it's not as small as older compact phones like the Pixel 4 or iPhone 11, it is much more manageable than the usual 6.7 or 6.8-inch phones we see today. The form factor makes it comfortable to use one-handed, which is exactly what I wanted.

        📱 OxygenOS – OnePlus is Back!

        I previously used a OnePlus 7T Pro and loved the classic OxygenOS. After switching to iPhone 13 and Samsung S23, I finally returned to OnePlus with the 13S – and I’m so glad I did. The current OxygenOS is refined, stable, and close to stock Android, just like the old days. It feels like OnePlus is truly back in form.

        📸 Camera – Surprisingly Impressive

        I’m not a heavy camera user, but I do expect decent quality – and this phone delivers exactly that. Despite what some reviewers say, I personally found the camera quality quite impressive, and it satisfies my everyday photography needs very well.

        ✅ Verdict:

        If your priorities are amazing battery life, powerful flagship performance, compact usability, and a smooth, clean Android experience, the OnePlus 13S is an excellent choice. I absolutely recommend it to anyone looking for a practical and powerful smartphone.

        Wanted to buy iphone 17, but changed my mind. After a lot of thoughts and suffering from battery and space constraints in 2 iPhones, I decided to go back to android. Pixel 10 is comparable but this beast is cheaper I tell you. Get it with credit card offers!

        Camera: photo colour is a bit unrealistic and high on perfection but everything else from battery to customisation is a huge plus here.

        Battery is the biggest flex of this device. I only charge once a day, that too partially and used social media for hours. Still didn't go below 40% for the day (and night).

        I know the glass effect of iOS 26 is a killer but the range of customisation in android has been forever there and it's only getting better with time. I have no regrets! Only regret is that I couldn't transfer whatsapp message to this phone. Whatsapp should really work on transferability!! Or OnePlus should.

        The colour, the finish, the camera bump. Everything is sleek and gives a premium feel. Especially for iphone users, you got nothing to lose. Message app can really be worked on. iMessage was better at segregating.

        Size fit well for both small or big hand sizes. Heating isn't a big concern here. It gets mildly hot when charging but manual does recommend you to charge in a well ventilated area. Played some games for 2-3 hrs. But still found battery drainage or heating is not huge.

        Haven't tested it's durability because haven't dropped it yet, thanks to good quality rubber cover (see pic) that comes with the phone. And unlike samsung or apple, they do send the huge 80W charger (pic attached) with it. 😍😍 What else would one ask for? More colours maybe.

        ✅ Shifted from Samsung S20 FE to OnePlus 13 S – My Experience

        Performance: The processor is lightning fast and highly efficient – everything feels super smooth.

        Battery Life: Easily lasts a full day, much better than my old phone. One of the best in this segment.

        Camera: Overall quality is decent but not the best. However, the portrait mode produces excellent results and the selfie camera is among the best in this segment, with unbelievable detailing that feels underrated.

        Design & Build: Classy, premium, and handy in size – it truly looks and feels like a flagship.

        Extra Features: AI-powered photo editing is a nice addition. The built-in document scanner in the camera app is a huge plus, making external apps like CamScanner, Adobe Scan, or Oken unnecessary.

        Software/UI: Personally, I found Samsung’s UI a bit easier to use, but apart from that, the OnePlus 13 S stands out in performance, battery, display, and premium looks.

        ⚡ Room for improvement: A telephoto lens and wireless charging would have made this the ultimate flagship choice in its segment.

        Overall, it’s one of the best flagship phones.

          "Initially, I approached this purchase with a healthy dose of skepticism, opting for a pre-booking. However, from the moment I unboxed it, I was impressed. The front of the phone bears a striking resemblance to an iPhone, exuding a premium feel. Flipping it over, the quality of the back cover is immediately apparent – it feels genuinely high-end.

          One of my biggest concerns was performance, especially with graphics-intensive games like PUBG. I'm thrilled to report that there are absolutely no heating issues, even during extended gaming sessions. The camera, too, has been a pleasant surprise, consistently capturing excellent images, further enhanced by its impressive AI editing features. And the display? It's incredibly crisp and vibrant. What's more, the battery optimization is so good that you can enable all those battery-hungry animations and display settings and still comfortably get a full day of battery backup.

          A thoughtful feature I particularly appreciate is the option to restrict charging to 80%. Even with this limitation, I consistently achieve an impressive 7 hours of screen time, often with 25-30% battery life remaining by the end of the day.

          The user interface and animations are remarkably well-optimized, offering a smooth and fluid experience without any noticeable bugs so far. As someone who invests in a phone with a minimum multi-year horizon in mind – my last device was a Pixel 4a, which I moved on from due to its software and security support ending – this new phone truly fits the bill perfectly. I'm eagerly anticipating the Android 16 update!"

        About this Item

        • Elite Performance - At the core of OnePlus 13s, lies the Snapdragon 8 Elite – the fastest Snapdragon mobile processor, powering OnePlus AI, stunning graphics and next-gen performance. With state-of-the-art Cryo-Velocity cooling system, OnePlus 13s runs cool, no matter where you are.
        • Smarter Everyday – Experience the power of OnePlus AI with Oxygen OS 15 out of the box. Oxygren OS 15 brings deep improvements that power OnePlus AI, making organising your life easy with AI Plus Mind, enhancing efficiency with Intelligent Search and improving productivity with Google Gemini.
        • Outlast Everything – At 5850mAh(typ) OnePlus 13s has the largest battery on a compact smartphone. It brings lasting endurance with up to 20 hours of YouTube playback, 16 hours of Instagram scrolling and 7+ hours of BGMI gaming. With 80W SUPERVOOC Fast Charge, charge up in no time.
        • Compact Powerhouse – OnePlus 13s brings a 16.05cm(6.32) Per-fit display housed in the most ergonomic form factor ever from the house of OnePlus. The 120Hz ProXDR Display brings movies and games to life.
        • Never Lose Focus – The 32MP front camera with Auto Focus, your selfies and groupfies are insta-ready, always. The 50MP + 50MP rear cameras ensure razor-sharp images with studio-grade details. With Clear Burst, never miss your precious moments.
        • Enhanced Connectivity – Be future-ready, with the first ever independent G1 Wi-Fi chipset on a OnePlus smartphone, support for 5.5G, and 360-degree antenna system for a seamless connectivity experience.
